eval_dimensions.name: Phase 0 Posture Check
eval_dimensions.description: Phase 0 reads the durable review posture through supervisor_review_status and delegates the ask to Dev10x:friction-setup before any work begins, so nested work-on invocations inherit a settled posture

eval_dimensions.name: Parallel Work Dispatch
eval_dimensions.description: Independent work items are dispatched to parallel agents or worktrees with proper isolation

evals.name: phase0-posture-check
evals.description: Tests that Phase 0 settles the review posture through supervisor_review_status before dispatching any work items, delegating the ask rather than offering a friction-level picker (ADR-0022).
evals.expected_output: supervisor_review_status is called before any issue processing begins; an unpinned project delegates to Dev10x:friction-setup, a pinned one proceeds silently. No friction-level options are offered and no session file is written.

assertions.text: supervisor_review_status is called before any work item dispatch, rather than reading friction.yaml directly
When pinned is false, the ask is delegated to Dev10x:friction-setup instead of being asked inline
When pinned is true, the posture is adopted silently — no AskUserQuestion and no delegation
No strict/guided/adaptive friction-level picker is offered — adaptive is the sole shipped baseline (ADR-0022 D-1)
fanout writes no friction.yaml or session file with the Write tool; persistence goes through the pin/set-friction writers
